nodes.label: AgentService
nodes.author: Jeremy JEANNE
nodes.rationale: Central orchestrator for AI conversations: tool execution loop capped at 10 iterations for loop protection; approval check combines requires_approval, auto_approve flags, and user callback.

nodes.label: Provider Trait
nodes.author: Jeremy JEANNE
nodes.rationale: Unified interface (complete/stream/cost/context_window/capability flags) so all LLM backends are interchangeable behind Arc<dyn Provider>.

nodes.label: Tool Trait
nodes.author: Jeremy JEANNE
nodes.rationale: 21 tools implement name/description/input_schema/capabilities/requires_approval/execute; capability enum plus a flat requires_approval boolean drive the approval system.

nodes.label: PromptAnalyzer
nodes.author: Jeremy JEANNE
nodes.rationale: Regex-based keyword detection injects TOOL HINT text into prompts to steer the LLM toward the right tool (plan, read_file, grep, etc.) without an extra model call.

nodes.label: Streaming Architecture
nodes.author: Jeremy JEANNE
nodes.rationale: Tokens flow over an unbounded mpsc channel from drain_stream_to_response to the TUI; forwarder_handle is awaited before ResponseComplete is emitted, guaranteeing all ResponseChunk events are already in the TUI channel — FIFO ordering with no race.

nodes.label: Reasoning/Thinking Display Pipeline
nodes.author: Jeremy JEANNE
nodes.rationale: Three sources unified into ContentBlock::Thinking; priority logic in from_openai_response prefers the reasoning_content field (content preserved verbatim) and only falls back to <think> tag stripping when it's absent; route_text_delta hides in-think text from the live stream, with extract_think_tags as a post-stream safety net.

nodes.label: extract_think_tags
nodes.author: Jeremy JEANNE
nodes.rationale: Case-sensitive by design (<think> only) to match DeepSeek/QwQ output; an unclosed <think> tag treats the rest of the string as thinking.

nodes.label: SubAgentLauncher Trait
nodes.author: Jeremy JEANNE
nodes.rationale: Injected into ToolExecutionContext by AgentService so AgentTool can spawn sub-agents without knowing AgentService internals; launched sub-agents get allow_sub_agents=false to prevent infinite recursion.

nodes.label: Repository Pattern
nodes.author: Jeremy JEANNE
nodes.rationale: Session/Message/Plan/File repositories abstract SQLite access from the service layer — cleaner separation than the Go original per the spec review.

nodes.label: Read-Only Mode
nodes.author: Jeremy JEANNE
nodes.rationale: Plan-mode restriction: write_file/edit_file/execute_code/notebook_edit/agent blocked outright; bash filters unsafe commands; powershell restricted to an allowlist of safe cmdlets.
